title: Hiding Banner Ads On a Specific SEO Template | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Hiding Banner Ads On a Specific SEO Template Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000054639 Steps Navigate to My Content > SEO Templates . Select the SEO template that contains the ad to be hidden, then click Edit . Click the Page Options tab. Select Hide Banner Ad Modules . For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate?
